module.name: fingerprintmatcher.py
module.why_this_is_checked: a package whose two distributions ship different modules has no single answer to 'what does it do', and this stage's whole method is to read one file

why_contradictory: opencv-python and opencv-contrib-python are alternative builds of the same cv2 module and are not supported side by side. The entry point calls cv2.xfeatures2d.SIFT_create, which the main distribution does not provide: on opencv-python 5.0.0, cv2 exposes SIFT_create at the top level and has no xfeatures2d attribute at all. Recorded as an observation; the gate does not turn on it
why_not_the_repository: the official repository does not presently show fingerprintmatcher.py at its root, and PyPI is what a `pip install` resolves. The bytes that would run are the bytes that get read
